title: The Model Decides, Code Gates Every Action

title: A Blog With No Backend: Markdown, React, and GitHub Pages
summary: How this blog works: posts are markdown files in the site's git repo, rendered client-side. There's no CMS, no database, and no auth system — and yet only I can publish, because publishing is a git push.
